svg.title: Black Monarch: redrawn body
svg.desc: Zac's redraw of the Black Monarch (2026-11-11), fitted to the 400 x 400 kit sheet with the axis on x = 200 so that the upper wings sit exactly where kit part P171 does. New: horns, head and body. The wings are the kit's own shapes; the lower pair sits a little lower than before.
